name: Tabby Viewfield
description: Render a Viewfield's views as tabs.
project_description:
This modules create a field formatter for fields of type viewfield to allow placing each item in a different tab.

 Features 
 The title and an array of behaviours to be attached can be set for each tab.

 Post-Installation 
 Go to manage display for an entity with a view field, and choose the "Tabby viewfield" format.

Edit the settings to set each tab title, and any behaviours that should be attached.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module relies on tabby .
